failures.claim: At 844×390 the results--long-list stage (8 rows) overflows the screen. The 'RACE COMPLETE' label is pushed off the top and the RETRY / NEXT RACE buttons are cut off at the bottom. Six rows fit, and real races can't have more than six cars today, but nothing guards the layout if the list grows. Let the rows shrink or scroll, or cap the stage fixture.
failures.evidence: screenshots/844x390/stage/results--long-list.png: rows 1–8 fill the height, the NEXT RACE button is clipped at y=390 and the label above BRAMBLE BENDS is missing. results--podium.png (6 rows) fits.

failures.claim: The spec says the sim and its grid code stay as they are, but the diff adds a curved-centreline placement for grid slots ≥4 (GRID_CURVED_FROM / GRID_CURVED_COLUMN). The plan audit allowed this only if a slot failed the prop check, and it asked for a journal note. The results-screen restructure (results-screen.ts, results.css) is also outside the expected files. Both look justified, but the PR should state why the grid change was needed.

failures.claim: The test mocks a `playerLivery` export from src/render/index.ts that game.ts doesn't use, which looks copied from somewhere else. It also relies on raceDrivers throwing for carCount 7, which the diff never shows. Drop the stray mock and assert the documented 1–6 range explicitly.
failures.evidence: `playerLivery: (n: number) => ({ body: 'rally-red', ... })` in vi.mock. `expect(() => game.startRace({ ..., carCount: 7 })).toThrow();`

structured_output.summary: The build is B04, the six-car grid. In game.ts, RACE, RETRY, RESTART RACE and NEXT RACE now pass carCount 6. startRace still defaults to 2 cars, as the spec asks. Each AI car gets its own seeded bot, and the cached scene is now keyed on track plus driver count. The HUD and minimap get their colours and labels from the driver list. Grid slots from index 4 on follow the centreline in narrower columns so they stay on dirt and clear of props; G3 replays still match main. The results screen was reorganised to be closer to the S5 mockup (stripe across the full width, buttons under the table) so six rows fit at 844×390, and the podium screenshot confirms they do. The tests go through the public game and DOM seams. They cover every AC: RACE gives 6 cars, the grid holds on all tracks for seeds 1–20 and clears props, POS reads 1/6, the minimap shows six dots with red drawn last, the AI cars move off the grid, all six racers finish and the results list the roster in order, AI finish ticks are distinct and reproduce, and RETRY / RESTART / NEXT each start a six-car race. All gates are green. Minor issues: an 8-row stage fixture still overflows on the phone, the sim/results changes go beyond the expected file list, and one test has a stray mock. The gate race screenshots still show 2 cars because of the protected driver, which the plan audit already flagged.
